scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w server && npm run coverage -w web
scripts.gitleaks: command -v gitleaks >/dev/null || { echo 'gitleaks is required for this check: brew install gitleaks'; exit 1; }; gitleaks dir . --no-banner --redact
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run gitleaks && npm run check:secrets && npm run knip && npm run coverage
